description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Order on Lubricating Oils (Base Oils) Lubricants etc. ( Revenue Protection Order No. 02/2020)
categorisation: This gazette notification contains a resolution passed by Parliament under Section 10 of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that modifies import duty rates on specific goods. It establishes new regulatory requirements for customs duties on petroleum oils, lubricating oils, and lubricants, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning the modification of existing legislation and tariff regulations.
